title: Design Twitter
keyIdea: Store tweets per user with a global timestamp; store followees in a set. getNewsFeed merges the users' tweet lists newest-first with a max-heap holding one tweet per user, stopping at 10 (like merging k sorted lists).

approaches.name: Collect all tweets and sort
approaches.idea: Gather every tweet of the user and their followees, sort newest first, take 10.
approaches.why: Sorts every relevant tweet even though only 10 are needed.

approaches.name: Max-heap merge of each user's newest tweets
approaches.idea: Push each user's newest tweet {time, user, index}; pop the newest, push that user's next older one; stop at 10.
approaches.why: The heap holds one tweet per followed user; only 10 pops are ever needed.
